text:
Cannot recommend enough. So friendly and skilled, cared very much about his work. Very comfortable and chill vibe. Excellent price for the work of an artist.
I'm sure anyone who rated less than 5 stars is someone you would not want as a customer.
I went in for a full head and face shave. He did a fantastic job and finished it off with a face and neck massage. If I lived here, I’d probably go there every week.

Went to get my beard trimmed and cleaned up and the super friendly barber always made sure its the length I wanted and the height of the trim line was okay and not too low etc. before cutting too far. Small shop and I only had to wait at most 5 minutes before the customer before me was done. The price was also cheap with 150 baht for the trim. Can only recommend it.

Does not listen to a word you say. Showed him a photo and explained what haircut I wanted (0.5 on the sides low fade and a trim on the top) but decided to do his own thing, shaved the whole back and sides a number 1, cut my fringe so unevenly and short and gave me a quiff. Literally google “pan flute” and that is what my fringe looked like.

Love the place when I first walked in. The barber has great taste in music, so you can enjoy some tunes while you sit and wait (there were 2 other people before me). Friendly guy, great environment and most importantly a great hair cut for a reasonable amount. If I need another hair cut before leaving Chiang Mai, I will go back!

Very nice barber with a lot of experience, the place doesn’t look fancy but on places like this is strongly recommended to not judge the book by his cover. The barber can speak English and i really like his style, highly recommended for everyone who wants a fresh cut🙏

I had a great experience. I showed up and there was no wait or line, and my haircut was fast. Barber had a wonderful welcoming aura and nice personality. I showed him a picture for reference, and together we got my desired style. I am very pleased ! 😍 …

This guy made me smile! Great cut and great taste in music. He has a really friendly way and a truly relaxing personality.
Really enjoyed the stay at his shop and
can recommend a visit 10/10.

An amazing experience. This is an open-style barber shop where you can walk in anytime, sometimes there’s a short wait, but I was able to sit down straight away. You can immediately tell he takes a lot of care with every single cut and every adjustment, whether it’s your hair or your beard.

It’s genuinely one of the best barber experiences I’ve ever had. On top of that, he can sing so you get a great haircut and a bit of entertainment.

Great job. Thank you!

The other reviews were correct, good barber who is meticulous even though I just needed minimal cut. One chair shop so wait your turn if it's busy. Prices at $300thb is good compared with USA pricing. I would recommend this place as I will be back in 3 weeks when my sides grows out.

text:
I asked for a clean shave; I got the full service and a nice neck/head massage as well.

The barber is very gentle and friendly and hummed along with the oldies he was listening to
I'm an easy customer ( almost bold, lol). The barber is friendly, quick, reasonably priced and speaks English. He did a great job trimming my facial hair.
We had an incredible cut from Open Barbers and he did exactly what we asked for! Will definitely visit again when we’re back !!
Very skilled barber. One of the best. I asked for a zero fade and trim. They took time and care to do a great job. Even align the sides properly. Highly recommend
Fiancé needed a beard trim, and was able to walk in no problem. It also comes with a good message.
Great barber! A real pro, quick and precise. Just tell him what you'd like or even show him a picture and he's ready to go. Also, he .has very good English. Very fair price

Do not be fooled by the appearance of the shop. You don't want to get your hair cut anywhere else. This guy is quite possibly the best barber in Chiang Mai. I showed him a photo of a haircut that 3 expensive professional barbers in Australia weren't able to replicate. He didn't even look at the photo for 5 seconds. He copied it perfectly. Effortlessly. Like it was nothing. Seriously skilled guy and super humble and lovely.
Had a brilliant hair cut here! Barber is absolutely maticulous ensuring a great shape to the cut.  Some great old school tracks on in the background too.

I requested a neck trim, around the ears and a shave. The hair cut trim was perfect!
Although, the shave is not "the best," as some say. At 60, I've had many shaves in my life, I know what the best shave is supposed to feel like.
Almost every swipe of the blade during shaving, pulled my facial hairs. I actually stopped him and asked if the blade was dull. I believe the problem is, it is not a "hot shave" to begin with. The skin and facial hair need to be properly prepared.
The second thing is that whatever he used to wet the skin is not optimal. No cream or foam is used if that is what you like. I like a hot towel, foaming shave that doesn't feel like it is pulling my hair ... that is not what you get here.
If you are sensitive to smells,  this very small space smells like cigarette smoke, I almost did not stay.
The barber is a cool guy, casual relaxed atmosphere and great music in the background.
There is one barber and one chair.
For a haircut, he's got you covered, but choose another for the shave.
This place gets 4.5 stars for the haircut/trim,  but 2.5 -3 stars for the shave.

Avoid….just hacked away at my hair going to short and when I said to short he just stopped cutting the to so now I have half an haircut. Wouldn’t recommend at all and expensive for Thailand at 350 baht
Easily the most meticulous barber I’ve ever visited. Spotless execution and not a single stray hair left behind. Highly recommended

I'm Italian tourist and needed a haircut, and I found this place very convenient. The guy who cut my hair was very good and professional, so much so that he managed to manage my hair, which is really complicated, and gave me a cut that I …
Perfect. Good music. Fast and good. Friendly. Professional
Great haircut… probably my best ever. Singing barber with attention to detail!! Great place for a haircut in Chiang Mai!
Lovely barber (and a good singer as well!), quality haircut and beard lineup, and good pricing! Can’t ask for much more!

I’ve been travelling for nearly 3 months and my hair was in a bad way. I stopped in here after grabbing a coffee down the street. I’m so glad I’d did, I explained how I get my hair cut and I got exactly what I was hoping for. 100% recommend stopping in here if you want to get your hair cut

Asked for a trim and taper and then he proceeded to destroy my hair. The guy was cocky and arrogant and basically just completely ignored what I asked for and did his own thing. Awful barber. He must be paying people to give him good reviews or there must be another guy who works there because honestly he gave me the worst haircut I have ever had in my entire life

Open Barber was one of the best haircuts I’ve received around Asia. A very kind person who really cares about his job he was very thorough with how I wanted my hair before cutting it. A very fair price too! I definitely recommend!
Got a fade cut, and it turned out to be one of the best cuts I ever got! Super professional and precise. The barber was really nice and cool! Amazing place to get a quick haircut :)
Highly recommended. I’m always really satisfied every time I get my hair cut here. There’s also parking available, which is great.

Wanted a barber that does nice skin fade . Excellent barber he knows what hes doing. So apologetic and understands english well. If you looking for barber. Do not look anywhere else. 300bhat is good price u pay more than this for alcohol;)
Open is a solid barber. I would recommend anyone looking for a haircut to check out his shop.

It’s such a joy to see someone so passionate and dedicated to their craft.

Thank you for the excellent haircut 🙏🙏
Best barber I have ever been at, super nice guy and very good at details. 10/10 recommend
One chair shop but the guy knows what he's doing. I needed a quick trim and clean up around my ears. He did a fantastic job. He also has a great singing voice hahah - thanks for the great cut!
Just went in for a trim on my beard, and he went above and beyond.  Triming around the ears and lining up the back of my neck. Excellent work, and I would highly recommend this barber.
Love this place - barber is a great character and very good. He does fancy cuts well, and he does simple cuts like mine well. All for $8. Can’t beat it!

text: Absolute gem of a find, friendly place, played great music & put a lot of effort into the cut, also saved my beard, couldn’t recommend enough

Spotted this gem of a barbershop while riding around d on my bicycle. So I stopped for a face shave. Best shave I've had in all my travels over the last 4 months. The shop itself is a classic barbershop playing classic oldies from the USA. Everything about my experience was 5 star.
Fantastic barber. Popped in for a beard trim and shave, was in the chair for an hour. Excellent skill and talent. Definitely pop in to see these two for a grooming.
I showed a picture of what I wanted and I got exactly what I showed. Very nice and great singer. I would come back

I got a great haircut here in the Old City, it was quick, he cut my hair as I asked, and it is a good deal at 200 baht, versus 350 and up over in the Nimman area. All while listening to Queen and The Beatles. I've had may har cut in many …
Great place to get a great cut. Barber was professional and did a great job on my overgrown gnarly hair. Don’t go hoping, go to Open.
I came here based on reviews and was not disappointed. Excellent cut, beard and neck trim. A well lit and airy barbershop. Would recommend!
A true professional that cares about doing the best possible cut.  Not just a barber, but a beard artist.

Wanted a quick head shave and was able to walk in straight without an appointment. Got started without any waiting. Very chill guy and plays great music. Gave me a great trim as well. Very happy with my experience.

Daughters wedding in 5 days. Had a cut elsewhere 2 weeks ago. Daughter said it was no good! Was in Chiang Mai to pick up my sister from Aus for the wedding. Dropped in to Open's for a quick makeover. Unbelievable skills. Knew what to do and offered recommendations. Great banter with his assistant while we waited. End result is one of the best haircuts I've ever had and I'm 64! Don't be fooled by this humble little shop - it's up there with the best.

A passionate barber, a timeless playlist, an immaculate haircut.

Sit back and enjoy this experience. Not many barbers will care for your hair the way he will.
The best haircut I’ve had in Asia. Showed him a picture and he did an incredible job with really nice attention to detail, super happy I came here. 10/10 will come to Open Barber again

Was en route to a barbershop I'd seen on a best-of list, but decided to give this a shot. Glad I did. No waiting and he understood just what I was looking for. Got the details right, including shading my beard into my fade, a hard part, …
Friendly service, great result.
Great barbershop! Great barber! Great haircut! Great music!

Very meticulous , chill guy, best haircut in a long time.
I needed a coffee so I came back so basically no wait at all.
It's a unique experience! The barber cuts the hair very nice!

I am sorry. Wish I could say nice things. But I also must be honest.
I am bold. I went to shave my head and my beard. The head was ok. But the face was awful.  The man didn't use hot towels. Almost no shavingcream so the shaving felt like shaving complete dry. The knife didn't  cut but was pooling out my beard. It hurted a lot. Told the gentleman a few times but he was laughing. Result... a very burning face and I absolutely not smooth shaved. I still feel hair.
After the gentleman gave a short face/head/nek massge. That was so rough that I my nek is hurting.
Am so sorry but I think a review should be honest.
I went to have a nive relaxed shaving but it went totally wrong.
Not satisfied
Great Job Sir

Delightful!
10/10 ❤️
Excellent service with music playing. Head and beard shaved, plus a little massage. Great job! Thank you for everything.
Perfect haircut! Also, amazing singer!!!

Excellent barber/hairdresser who cuts with scissors 🙌🙌🙌🙌

Thanks man for your work, and as soon as I'm back in Chiang Mai I'll definitely come back to listen to the music you play in your salon 😉

I had my hair cut here again when I visited Chiang Mai. This was my third time. The cheerful owner remembered me and I was very happy. I was satisfied with how well my hair looked this time too. I highly recommend it.
Perfect.
Friendly and talented. Comfortable and cool facility

Whatever you ask, he does it.

The short relaxing massage at the end was five stars, I almost fell asleep.

I recommend it, you can go!!!
Greaaaat barber! Thank you! Greetings from Croatia!
I really liked the haircut, also he was very polite and attentive. 10/10
Fast, high-quality, with a song and a smile!
Sorry guys, cannot recommened this place.. the razor was not sharp, and a price wayyy too expensive..

This is my second year in Chiang Mai. He loves his job, and this tiny place exudes a positive vibe. The owner is a friendly guy who enjoys singing while he works with his customers. Highly recommended!
Amazing work with both the hair and the beard! Great attention to details.

Great, precise haircut, shave, quiet barbershop, my favorite 50's and 60's music was playing in the background, which the barber perfectly complemented with his singing. 💈 very positive atmosphere 👍 …

In short: perfect. I decided at the last minute (haircut and beard shave). A few Google reviews convinced me. And I'm thrilled. Plus, there's excellent music and the owner is very friendly. Go for it!!
Great haircut, great service, great music. Highly recommendable.
A simple yet magical place. The singing barber, also skilled at giving head massages, put me in a good mood and gave me a flawless shave.

You can go there with your eyes closed!! A true professional, very meticulous, one of the best barbers I've ever seen.

500 baht for a haircut and beard trim.
Every year I get a fantastic haircut with background music!! It was great in the old shop, and he's done a superb job in the new one too!
Very good haircut and attention to detail 👌🏾 …
Very good experience. They are super kind. Thank you!
